newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia foreign investment growth seen slowing.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia foreign investment growth seen slowing.

text.p: Indonesia's foreign investment growth was likely to slow down in 1996 and 1997, the official Antara news agency reported on Monday.
Antara quoted a report from the Central Bureau of Statistics as saying foreign investment growth would decline to 15 percent in 1996 and 1997 from 25 percent last year.
The report said inconsistency in microeconomic policy was responsible for the slowdown, apart from high domestic interest rates. It did not give details.
It said the slowdown may restrict gross domestic product (GDP) growth to 7.67 percent in 1996 and 7.91 percent next year, respectively.
Indonesia posted GDP growth of 8.07 percent in 1995.
